note: Overnight Fri->Sat 2026-10-23/24 (v0.1.5 release plan, Tue 10-27): ONE clean-machine queue, 25 jobs, timeout sum 736 min (12.3 h); expected wall time ~8 h (10-min profile jobs take ~12 min, loop jobs stop at their firing count). START (Rodney, 18:00 PHT, from the main checkout after merging this branch): set TS3_NIGHT=1 so a failed job does not stop the queue, then node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/overnight-1023.json (PowerShell: $env:TS3_NIGHT=1; node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/overnight-1023.json). Expected end ~02:00-03:00 PHT; worst case (every job at its timeout) ~06:30 PHT, before the 08:00 PHT end of the quiet window. NOTHING ELSE may run while it goes: no agents, no builds, no other queue, no use of the PC (timing runs; machine-load line must stay < 10% other CPU). Resume after a stop: same command with --from <job id>. Order: (1) clean-night-1023 (Overwatch v2 confirm, lock-taker A/B; moved to asi.0338), (2) clean-night-1024 (T1, refcount guard, D1+H2Ic), (3) DoorMemo verify + 4 A/B jobs on 0338, (4) provisional v0.1.5 bundle A/B BP/IP/SV both orders, natural play, (5) README vanilla vs v0.1.4 vs candidate, 1 load per side per world. Read each job with the reader named in its note (hitch-ab.ts --scenario for loop jobs, hitch-ab.ts pair means for --ab jobs, release-vs-baseline-report.ts for part 5).
